title.narrative: UNICEF ensured care continuity for vulnerable children and mothers despite 424 closed health facilities, with 35,501 home visits by CHWs improving neonatal survival. Reaching 371,902 children via iCCM, stabilizing vaccination at 76–80%, and strengthening infrastructure—including oxygen plants—UNICEF supported over 200,000 people while enhancing health governance in crisis settings.
